info.name: MaternaVault Backend API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection for MaternaVault Edge Clinical API & Central Cloud Backend. Includes full payload bodies, multi-tenant parameters, RBAC supervisory triggers, sync queues, and HL7 FHIR R4 interoperability.

request.description: Inspects server status, active ML inference models (XGBoost, SMOTE-XGB, ADASYN-XGB), AES-256-GCM local database encryption telemetry, and PostgreSQL central connection state.

item.name: Mobile Emergency Health Pass Web Viewer

request.description: Lightweight emergency maternal clinical summary view rendered directly in mobile browser when a paramedic or clinician scans the patient's QR pass.
Fetches all authorized clinic tenant stations (e.g., clinic-ambagamuwa, clinic-4b-rampur, clinic-02-kandy).
Returns authorized clinicians, PHM midwives, and MOH doctors scoped to the selected clinic.

item.name: Get Patient Optical QR Code Pass

request.description: Generates ECDSA P-256 signed optical QR payload data URL (Table 4.5 compact optical format with CRC-32 and SHA-256 integrity verification).
Deletes patient record from both Local Encrypted DB and central PostgreSQL database without resurrecting on refresh.

item.name: Get Central DB Sync Status & Telemetry

request.description: Provides sync telemetry: central PostgreSQL connectivity, total records, unpushed count, last sync timestamp, and encryption checksum.
Runs connectivity probe against cloud PostgreSQL to verify uplink latency and determine if a sync cycle should be started.
Initiates immediate bidirectional synchronization cycle between the offline encrypted station and central cloud PostgreSQL.
Ingests offline batched mutations protected by SHA-256 idempotency filtering (Section 4.6.3 Sequence Diagram Step 3).
Exports maternal clinical demographics conforming strictly to HL7 FHIR R4 StructureDefinition/Patient.

Exports longitudinal maternal clinical record as an HL7 FHIR R4 transaction bundle containing Patient, Observations (LOINC 85354-9 Blood Pressure, LOINC 29463-7 Weight, LOINC 718-7 Hemoglobin), and RiskAssessment resources.
Ingests external HL7 FHIR R4 clinical bundle into MaternaVault, deserializing LOINC vitals and creating or updating patient records (Section 4.4.3 NFR-03 & Section 4.8.1).
